scope: Exploratory reuse of previously viewed PhysioCGM; parameter/decision/sensor-availability study, not confirmation
outer_split: Unchanged v2.1 60/20/20 with60-minute input and15-minute label-support purge and crossing-event exclusions
inner_split: First75% of each outer training time span for tuning fit, last25% for tuning evaluation;60/15-minute support purge. No outer-validation or test labels choose model hyperparameters.
primary_control: pooled_mask_clock with identical union availability; legacy v2 static and clock also retained
normalization: Per-person earlier-training reference-normal median/IQR and normal HR-on-activity/time ridge fit; baseline normal labels are training-only CGM labels. Fixed zero imputation in normalized units. No glucose input at inference.
availability: Wrist arms retain exactly v2.1 full-wrist gate. Fallback and mask-control permit same wrist gate OR >=90% complete valid five-minute ECG; absent modality inputs masked, not carried forward.
hyperparameter_selection: Highest mean within-person inner average precision; single-class inner partitions NA. Ties favor first fixed candidate. Shared models equalize participant total training weights.
policy_definition: Legacy unchanged release-based30min cooldown. New policies require2 consecutive high points,2 consecutive low points to clear,30min since actual alert before next; optional30min reminder only while score high. Span3 causal EMA for smooth policies. Gaps>7.5min reset; missing scores cannot confirm.
decision_selection: Outer validation only: maximize subject-macro event recall under pooled unmatched-alerts/reference-person-day budget, then fewer unmatched alerts/day, then policy order and larger threshold. Personal mode uses each own validation; shared mode uses all earlier validation. Zero-recall ties can disable alerts.
reference: Unchanged native<70mg/dL, observed low-run>=15min, one-to-one current-event matching; all eligible events retained including absent input. No lead-time claim.
